basics.label: Backend Developer · Elixir, Phoenix, PostgreSQL
basics.summary: Backend developer with more than 12 years of experience and a five-year focus on Elixir. I design application architecture, model business rules and data lifecycles, and build integrations with payments, messaging, and event queues. Comfortable as a team member, a technical lead, or the person who designs the architecture.

highlights: Led the redesign and maintenance of the Clarovideo streaming app for Android mobile and set-top boxes.
Managed six developers by delegating tickets and providing technical guidance.
Built the Shipping Routing Tables application in Symfony to manage all delivery routing tables, communicating with third-party shipping providers.
Reviewed and fixed issues in the Go script that synchronized merchandise from the back office to the e-commerce storefront.
